environment.description: Same application deployed in ECS Fargate task with custom task definition. Task role has no permissions beyond ECR pull. Container uses custom seccomp profile derived from moby default but with additional restrictions: personality(2), ptrace(2), and crucially clone(2) with CLONE_NEWUSER flag denied. The ImageMagick policy.xml restricts coders to PNG/JPEG/GIF/WEBP only (no SVG, no MVG, no ephemeral, no URL, no MSL). Additionally, the Fargate task runs with readonlyRootFilesystem=true with only /tmp mounted as ephemeral storage, and the container's PATH is restricted to /usr/local/bin:/usr/bin — pandoc and exiftool binaries are present but shell metacharacter expansion is handled by busybox ash (not bash), which does not support process substitution or $() in unquoted contexts within the f-string interpolation path.
